summary.name: Twistavo
summary.one_liner: Twistavo is an AI video studio for character swap that replaces a person in an existing video with an AI character built from 1 to 4 photos, plus AI image and video generation from many models.
use_cases: Replace a person in a real video with an AI character
Make trending-style videos with your own AI character
Generate AI images from text prompts
Create AI videos from images or prompts
Remix short clips without installing software
summary.what_it_does: Twistavo lets you drop in an existing video, pick a character, and get a remixed version in minutes, with the set and motion kept. The Influencer Studio takes a trending video or a 4 to 15 second upload and assigns one of your AI characters to each person, up to 8. It also offers AI image and video generation from multiple models, with 67 models and 15 studios named in the page description. Each generation shows its credit price before it runs, and failed or refused generations return credits. It runs in the browser on phone or computer.
notable: Influencer Studio swaps AI characters into trending or uploaded videos, up to 8 people
Each run shows its credit cost before generating; failed runs refund credits
Creates a character from 1 to 4 photos
No app install; explicitly no mobile app
caveats: Videos require a paid plan; only one free image after signup
Plans start at $3.99/month for 180 credits; a 5 s Kling 3.0 clip with sound costs 76 credits
Character swap is for adults only
